description: Dept. of Inland Revenue - Notification  specify the taxes or other levies which the deductions shall not be made in calculating a person's income
reasoning: This gazette notification contains regulations made under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifying which taxes or levies shall not be deducted when calculating a person's income. It establishes legal/regulatory framework for tax calculations and references multiple existing tax laws (Economic Service Charge Act, Value Added Tax Act, Nation Building Tax Act, Finance Acts). This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes or organizational matters.
